reader.send-enter-interrupt.description: Native output, Send, Enter/approve and Interrupt, with independent console receipts. Action evidence: driver-transcript.txt records + tap_desc 'Send prompt', + tap_text 'Enter / approve' and + tap_text 'Interrupt session'. Result evidence: 10-send-result.xml contains VERIFY_RECEIVED:VERIFY_SENT_528, 12-enter-result.xml contains VERIFY_ENTER_528, and 14-interrupt-result.xml contains VERIFY_INTERRUPTED_528. These markers are substrings of multiline text attributes, not standalone text="marker" attributes. Independent side-effect evidence: receipts.txt and tmux-final.txt retain all three literal markers. Quote the marker substring verbatim, without inventing XML attribute boundaries.

legacy.igsh-449.description: Approve or deny a pending second device on the shipping screen; install/remove its key on the trusted fixture host and verify access from that device. The local account authority completes real OAuth/PKCE; production email OTP remains outside this UI proof.

legacy.igsh-429.description: a queued real app crash plus account-service receipt access. On a disposable debug install crash, relaunch, complete **Sign in**, and verify the stable report id server-side. Check startup/sign-in drain, including dismissed reports; the console never crashes the app.

legacy.igsh-422.description: first-screen entry is automated. Sync needs OTP, account servers and host-sync capability. Complete **Sign in**, inspect **Session list actions → Hosts** and compare another device; offline hosts do not prove sync.

legacy.igsh-432.description: an agent transcript with multiple new assistant messages after a recorded read position. Read a session, leave, generate replies on the host, check Inbox's count (`<n> unread messages`), reopen and check it clears. The console is not an agent.

legacy.igsh-434.description: Deepgram credential, microphone permission, controlled speech/silence and network/audio evidence. Reader **Session actions → More → Dictation API key**, **API key → Save and dictate**, then **Start dictation / Stop dictation**. Verify transcript and silence gating; short pre-roll/hangover is intentional. IGSH-2286: on a phone with no key, sign in and the Dictation API key field reads Replacement API key with nothing typed; signed out, a hand-typed key still dictates.

legacy.igsh-423.description: saving needs OTP and a pulled account layout. **Session list actions → Settings → Show Frequent split**, Back, check **Frequent**; repeat off and compare another device. Not dispatchable in CI.

legacy.igsh-415.description: account-mapped sessions with input in 24 h, or three watch visits of at least 10 s in 6 h. Send input, return to **Frequent**, compare ordering; check watch-only fallback and **Settings → Newest sessions at bottom** separately.

legacy.igsh-426.description: The chat top bar shows the installed version beside Session actions. Its description is Version <version>, open release notes. Tapping it opens App updates. Inbox, settings and the live shell keep their own labels.

legacy.igsh-424.description: a supported agent (Claude) transcript on the SSH host, including tables/nested lists and model/effort state. Open from Inbox, scroll the complete transcript, inspect tables horizontally and top-bar subtitle; no **Conversation** header/status row. **Session actions → Session history** opens alternate-screen history. Console output proves none of this.

legacy.igsh-418.description: Long-press a Claude bubble, cancel Replying, then send a quoted reply. The host receipt contains the quote and the new text, the host accepts the prompt, and the reply bubble is never marked Not sent.

chat.mentions.description: Typing @ lists another chat under the real name the chat list shows, picking it inserts that name, and the sent text carries the tmux session so the desktop routes the mention to the right chat.

legacy.igsh-425.description: multi-touch and long/wide tmux output, no extra credential. **Open live terminal**, pinch (8–28 sp, retained on reopen), pan, swipe down or **Open shell history**, then **Jump to live** / **Back to the live view**. Terminal.md proves attachment only.

legacy.igsh-414.description: Inbox search keeps the keyboard open. The exact session row sits below the search box and above the keyboard.

legacy.igsh-413.description: Signed out, reader Session actions, then More, shows Sign in to sync. The journey does not complete sign-in. Inbox Session list actions does not contain that row.

reader.lifecycle.description: Hax and Claude stop snapshot and history requests while hidden, wake on return, and publish after another reader closes. Action evidence: driver-transcript.txt records adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME. Result evidence: reader-ui.json retains CODEX_REPLY_hax_HOST_WHILE_HIDDEN_hax and CODEX_REPLY_hax_AFTER_SECOND_READER_CLOSE. Independent side-effect evidence: hax-hidden-before.json and hax-hidden-after.json retain equal host request counts; hax-resumed.json retains increased counts. reader-second-close-receipt.txt records VERIFY_RECEIVED:AFTER_SECOND_READER_CLOSE. The *-result.txt files are assertion summaries, not independent side-effect citations.
